subject: Spark Session — Attendee triage & demo calendaring plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spark Session — initial triage + suggested routing

Morning — quick recap and an ask. We had ~410 registrants, 153 attendees live. I exported the attendee file and attached a cleaned CSV (spark_attendees_export_20260830.csv) plus the slide deck. My quick read: about 27 accounts look mid/enterprise and mapped to named AEs; ~60 are high-potential SMBs (good fit for SDR outreach).

Proposed routing:
- Tier A (named accounts / enterprise signals) -> route to AEs + schedule 30-min discovery with Ben this week.
- Tier B (mid-market) -> SDR 15-min intro + replay + tailored clip; goal: demo within 7 days.
- Tier C (nurture) -> automated nurture drip (2 emails over 14 days).

Lauren — can you draft a Tier A email template (one-pager + link to slides + 3 suggested demo times)? Put the HubSpot record link in footer.
Ben — please prioritize the top 12 Tier A accounts in the CSV and start booking; I’ve flagged them in column "routing_priority". If you need technical help, loop in Lauren or me.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SparkSessionAssets
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4782

Thanks — Priyom

--

Hi Sarah — thanks again for joining this morning's Spark Session. Wanted to pass along the on-demand recording and a short clip we pulled that highlights our latency/cost comparison for clinical-search use cases. Links/attachments below:
- Replay (trimmed): spark_replay_trimmed.mp4 (attached)
- Full slides: spark_session_slides.pdf (attached)
- Short clip: https://drive.google.com/file/d/clip-spark-001

We reviewed your brief in the Q&A and flagged Acme Health as Tier A for follow-up — Ben (cc'd) is my AE and would love to run a short discovery to understand your data residency and throughput needs. Suggested 30-min windows:
- Tue Aug 31: 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Aug 31: 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Sep 1: 11:00–11:30 PT

If those don't work, send a few times that do and Ben will send a calendar invite. We'll also prepare a short tech summary (latency benchmarks + caching options) for your team.

Best,
Priyom

- Procurement: we typically need a SOW + security questionnaire before commercial discussion; happy to share a template after the discovery.
